risk_notes: Selected importer supports non-interlaced PNG (128 MiB decoded scanline limit) and RIFF AVI container checks. Other MIME types are rejected.
AVI container validation is not a general codec playback proof. No rendering or transcoding is included.
Local import does not classify original AI generation or establish rights. Supplied rights references are recorded, not independently verified.
Registry assumes a dedicated directory protected from hostile concurrent ancestor replacement. It is not an OS sandbox or signed manifest system.
A real process crash may leave worker.lock; it is never automatically cleared. Interrupted provider invocations are never blindly repeated.
Actual native link boundary behavior remains unverified in this sandbox; deterministic rejection tests are separately identified.
Shared CLI/schema/packaging fan-in and A05 integration remain deferred as requested.
